_about: v16.4 Inside C only: the review fixes (2026-10-26), built in work/xvhs. One entry per finding of review-math.json (8) and review-user.json (10). status: fixed | partly-fixed | documented | deferred (a question for the user) | rejected (with the reason) | no-action. Evidence: node test/t_constr.js (section G, 37/37: 8 new checks), test/perp_cmd.js section J (7 new checks), evidence/fix-*. Browser: perp_cmd A–J 117/117 with no console errors (evidence/fix-perp_cmd_full.json; I8 BUDGET60: frame p95 16.7 ms, rAF work p95 1.4 ms seg vs 2.4 ms whole); node: all 34 test/t_*.js exit 0 (evidence/fix-node_tests.txt); make_ru_table --strict: 2398 entries, 0 unresolved (evidence/fix-ru_strict.log). Baselines (test/regress/perf/accepted.json, quality/baseline*.json, quality/golden) byte-identical to the main tree. Also re-run: constr_cmd 115/115 (the 3-point chip's touch class), i18n_cmd 94/94 (evidence/fix-constr_cmd.json, fix-i18n_cmd.json).

findings.fix: A line's arc is now drawn by Region's own line curves (region.js segCurvesOf, used by curvesOf and by the preview): the chord is a segment; the vertical ray and the two rays through infinity are longOf rays (FAR clip and, with {reach: 'sphere'}, c.reach), each running from the arc's start toward its end, the finite ends bitwise. So Lines.refine's tails, cutUnresolved and resolveFar and curvePieces' clip apply as to a whole line. constr.js segCurves now draws circles only (its line runs are gone).
findings.evidence: t_constr G 'seg (math-1, math-4): the vertical ray is a long ray with reach': real axis, P = 1+i, Q = 1+2i, X [-4,4]x[-3,3]: largest Im step under exp 0.25 rad (whole line 0.25; before 36.4); nearest 1/z image to 0: 3.0e-19 (whole 2.9e-19; before 9.1e-4); window of diagonal 0.25 around 1+i: 2.8e-19 (before ~0.035).

findings.fix: setSeg treats a glider at infinity as the point infinity: kept when infinity is on the drawn side (f_Gc there has the sign of Gc.A; 0 for a line), else its mirror image (mirrorIn now maps infinity <-> a circle's centre, a line keeps infinity). Off, it gets t = 1/2 when K's map is the M(R) one. projectPiece's seg branch maps infinity to u = 1/2: an infinite end is that end's t, else its t on the arc, else the nearer end.
findings.evidence: t_constr G: a glider at the ray's infinite end stays at infinity off (t 0.5) and on again (t 1); a glider at infinity on the whole line K stays at infinity when the switch turns on; two rays: projectPiece(infinity) is inside (0, 1) and glides to infinity; on the chord a glider at infinity goes to the centre (|p| < 1e-15) and Other side brings it back to infinity.

findings.fix: The outside of a circle C is written as a disc of the sphere: '\{|z|>1\}\cup\{\infty\}' (the same maths in Russian). The half-plane case is unchanged.
findings.evidence: perp_cmd J2: '…the hyperbolic line in the domain $\{|z|>1\}\cup\{\infty\}$ on the circle through $z_{0}$ and $z_{1}$ perpendicular to the circle $|z|=1$, in the $z$-plane.'

findings.fix: By math-1: the ray and the two rays are long curves, which curvePieces clips to clipWin, so integrals and Listen along get a finite clipped piece. The line-run f with tan(pi/2 ± eps) is gone (segCurves no longer draws lines); the long rays' f is linear and exact at 0 and 1.
findings.evidence: t_constr G 'the two rays through infinity: long rays with reach, f finite and straight to their clipped ends' (f(0), f(0.999), f(1) finite and in one direction on both runs) and 'the vertical ray … f(1) finite'. Browser (evidence/fix-integral-probe.json): 'Integrate F along it' (F = 1/z) on the vertical seg ray gives 1.0664 + 1.2194i over the visible part and on the two rays 0, with no 'singularity' message; before, the popover said the curve passes through a singularity.

findings.fix: Chose SPEC 4's reading (parallel geodesics have no meet): meetsOf returns no meet at either index for two hyperbolic lines of the same C that share an end (both infinity, or within 1e-9 of the larger arc's size). Their carriers touch only at that ideal point. Crossing geodesics are unchanged.
findings.evidence: t_constr G 'limiting parallels … have no meet at either index; crossing geodesics still meet': two vertical rays over the real axis (Re z = 1, 2) and two disc geodesics through e^{0.7i}: m0 and m1 both nomeet.

findings.fix: The ⋯ item names the side it turns on: 'Outside {c} only' when SPEC 2.2's side is the outside (a disc C drawn as its complement); 'Inside {c} only' and 'One side of {c} only' as before. New string menu.seg_out (RU «Только вне кривой: {c}»).
findings.evidence: perp_cmd J5: C a complement disc: the item reads 'Outside the circle of Disc 1 only' ({c} names C's boundary, the v16.3 user-13 rule) and after it the row reads 'hyperbolic line outside the circle of Disc 1, …'.

findings.fix: cap.seg ('through z0 and z1 in the domain …') only when P and Q are both finite and strictly on the drawn side (not on C by onCarrier's tolerance, seg * f_Gc < 0); otherwise cap.seg_on ('in the domain … on the circle through …'). The rows use the same test (user-6).
findings.evidence: perp_cmd J3: z0 = e^{0.7i} on C: '…the hyperbolic line in the domain $|z|<1$ on the circle through $z_{0}$ and $z_{1}$ perpendicular to the circle $|z|=1$…'; row 'hyperbolic line inside Circle 1, on the circle through z₀ and z₁'.

findings.fix: AS-BUILT now says that v16.2 (like Preimage, SPEC 6.1) draws the two-rays case as the chord inside C, the complement of what v16.4 draws. The cache is not changed to a 'ray' because a ray from one end is also wrong (half the curve), the case needs the outside side and the diameter case at once, and v16.2 is an old page.

Not built: a question for the user. The approved request (review-user.json user-14, 'the arc of K inside the picked curve, the arc between its two crossings with C') is what v16.4 draws. A third state 'Between z0 and z1' (the true hyperbolic segment, «гиперболический отрезок»: SPEC 2 with ends P and Q, undefined when P and Q are on opposite sides of C; in the chip, the Inspector and the ⋯ menu) is new scope with its own strings, gliders and meets. Question for the user, with shots/review-user/ru-exp2z.png: 'Also add Between z0 and z1, so a hyperbolic triangle draws without tails?'
findings.evidence: SPEC 12 and AS-BUILT 'Open' already list it.

findings.fix: Construct.phrase marks the seg captions close: true. shapePhrase then ends them with a closing comma {pc}; pcTidy (app.js: captionLatex, layoutCaption, __cmwCapText) drops it before punctuation, an opening bracket, another comma and at the end; for a list that a figure.js template continues it is left as U+2063 and figure.js's polish (pcOut) resolves it once the sentence is whole. figure.js us() keeps the mark. Russian: «…, проходящая через $z_1$ и~$z_2$, и~гиперболическая прямая …», «…через $z_2$ и~$z_0$, в~плоскости~$z$». No string changed. Follow-up for the merge, not done here: v16.3's own perp and touch captions («окружность, проходящая через … и ортогональная …») have the same open participle in Russian; with this mechanism the fix is close: 'ru' on those phrase returns, left out so the v16.3.1 round's captions do not change under it.
findings.evidence: perp_cmd J1 (RU, three seg lines): '$z_{2}$, и~гиперболическая прямая', '$z_{0}$, в~плоскости~$z$', '$z_{1}$, гиперболическая', and no ',,' ',.' ', (' or U+2063 in the article or homework caption.

findings.fix: The stacked 'in … in the z-plane' now reads '…in the domain $|z|<1$, in the $z$-plane' (the same closing comma as user-2). Grouping several lines into one 'in the domain' is not done: the caption lists shapes in drawing order everywhere, points between the lines, and lines may lie in different domains; grouping would reorder the list for one kind only.
findings.evidence: perp_cmd J1 (EN): '…and the hyperbolic line through $z_{2}$ and $z_{0}$ in the domain $|z|<1$, in the $z$-plane.', no stray comma in the article, on-screen and homework captions.

findings.fix: The Orthogonal chip chooses words or icons from its actual width after each text change: words first (not on touch), icons when the text then wraps or the chip passes its plane's right edge; the plane's width is in the chip's signature, so a resize re-measures. Whole's tooltip is 'Whole: the whole circle' (RU «Целиком: вся окружность»). The 3-point chip keeps v16.3's rule.
